integrity: The probability laws and polynomial identities are reproduced by two independently structured exact computations; the continuum sign claim is proved by Descartes' rule and endpoint signs. The code uses exact symbolic arithmetic and no simulation-based proof.
scientific_limitations: Exactly the two connected six-vertex cubic simple graphs; independent homogeneous bond transmission, uniform source. Not an automatic result for correlated transmission, continuous-time SIR infectious-period mixtures, or larger cubic graphs. Historical priority subject to additional specialized literature and independent review.
title: A sharp variance reversal despite stochastic outbreak dominance on cubic contact networks
